east_catalysts_risks.notes: No developments confirmed inside the 12–15 Oct 2026 window. The search tool returned no in-window articles. thehindu.com and deccanherald.com could not be fetched (blocked or HTTP 403), so the lead on BMRCL soil testing on Sarjapur Road (The Hindu, 15 Oct) could not be verified directly. Search snippets only suggest that Red Line (Phase 3A) geotechnical surveys were tendered and awarded in early 2026, and that the revised DPR awaits central approval; I did not report these because I could not quote the pages. The Trade Brains leads (Varthur/Panathur 135% appreciation, five next-Whitefield localities, the south-east IT boom) are weak SEO sources and did not surface. The Hoodi substation tree-felling item (Asianet) did not surface. The Devanahalli gas tanker accident is not relevant to property. The five claims returned are pre-window background on the Blue Line delay to 2027 and the ORR white-topping dispute. If a leading October start for ORR white-topping or Blue Line trial runs is confirmed, it would be the key in-window follow-up. Search snippets also mentioned the BBC (Peripheral Ring Road) first package awarded in June 2026, the Purple Line extension beyond Whitefield awarded in September, and the JLL Q2 2026 Bengaluru office report. I did not open those pages, so they are not reported as claims.

east_launches_prices.notes: No verifiable in-window (12-15 Oct 2026) launches, prices or RERA numbers found. The original Hindu soil-testing article (Sarjapur Road, Red Line) was not retrievable; only undated Deccan Herald snippets (state nod allowed geotechnical investigations; Sarjapur–Carmelaram elevated soil-test package incl. Sarjapur depot) were seen and are not reported because they couldn't be quoted from a fetched page. The Trade Brains leads and the Hoodi substation tree-felling item were not surfaced by search. Search results were dominated by low-quality listing/blog pages; the 5 claims above are background only. Candidates worth follow-up: Century Real Estate Marathahalli mixed-use (Rs 405 cr pre-launch bookings, Jan 2026), Brigade Gunjur, Purva Gunjur Rise, Arvind SmartSpaces Nagondanahalli, none verified on RERA portal.

government_watch.notes: The search tool was thin and The Hindu and Deccan Herald blocked fetches, so I verified only a few items. Not found or verified in the window: Hindu report on BMRCL soil testing on Sarjapur Road; BDA Karanth Layout deadline extension to 31 Oct (and the domicile-certificate story); Karnataka HC warning to BDA while upholding acquisition (ToI); GBA road network objections with maps unavailable (DH); Karnataka REAT Rs 2.45 lakh order (LiveLawBiz). Searches found no official BMRCL, BDA, K-RIDE or KIADB pages, and no cabinet, guidance value or stamp duty change in the window. The "Urban Acres" Pink Line March 2027 lead was not confirmed; other reports say the full corridor or the underground section is targeted for March 2027, but I did not record that as a claim. The metro heart-transport story is not property-relevant, and the search turned up a September 2025 precedent. Prestige Q2 (INR 7,225 crore pre-sales, 14 Oct) is a developer result, not government action, so I left it out of the claims.

metro_watch.notes: Search and fetch tools surfaced almost no pages dated inside the 12–15 Oct 2026 window. The Hindu lead on Sarjapur Road soil testing (15 Oct), the New Indian Express/TOI/Hindu organ-transport leads (14–15 Oct) and the Urban Acres Pink Line "March 2027" lead (14 Oct) could not be found or opened (thehindu.com was refused by the fetch tool). Search summaries suggest the March 2027 target applies to the underground Tavarekere–Nagawara section, not the elevated stretch. These details are unverified because I never saw a source page. Their dates and quotes are not confirmed, so I have not reported them as claims. The Deccan Herald Sampige Line (K-RIDE) tender, with bids due 9 October, appeared only in search summaries. Its publication year is not shown and the page was not opened, so I excluded it. The only in-window item is a non-official tracker's 12 Oct status. Treat it as weak evidence. As of ~12 Oct, no CMRS authorisation or official opening date for the Pink Line elevated section was found. The Hindu/BMRCL items should be re-checked by a later run.

north_south_west.notes: Few in-window items could be confirmed. The Hindu pages and the Deccan Herald Hebbal pages returned errors. I could not find the original articles for the Bannerghatta Road junction DPR (13-14 Oct), the Mysuru Road 60-year-old bridge, the Hebbal Finance Department concerns (TNIE), the Assetz Twin Lake City piece, or the Swan Realty Bodhi launch (Jayanagar, outside focus). I did not report them because I had no quotable text. A search summary said the cabinet approved Rs 2,215 crore for the Hebbal tunnel and Mehkri Circle elevated corridor, but I never saw the text on a page, so it is not a claim. Century Astoria (10 Oct), the Hilton signing (6 Oct) and the Hebbal tree counts (10 Oct) were published before the window opened (12 Oct 05:41 IST) and are marked with their true dates. The Hilton page showed no year; 2026 is inferred from the search listing. The Sadahalli items and the High Court order are background. Searches for Electronic City, Hosur Road, Kanakapura Road, Kengeri, Tumkur Road and Magadi Road found nothing dated in the window. Assetz Twin Lake City (Horamavu, about 21 acres, 1,220 homes, 3 and 4 BHK) appeared only on aggregators with conflicting prices and RERA reported as pending, so I left it out.

social_signals.notes:
No claims reported. I found no public YouTube, LinkedIn or Reddit content about East Bengaluru property for 12-15 Oct 2026.

Platform access:
- Reddit: WebFetch refused the domain, so r/bangalore could not be read at all.
- LinkedIn: only the sign-in page loaded. Public posts were not reachable without logging in.
- YouTube: the results page returned only footer text, with no video listings.
- Searches with site: filters for all three platforms returned only developer blogs, broker blogs and listing pages. None was dated inside the window, and none could be quoted verbatim from a page I opened.

Pages not opened: the Cushman & Wakefield Q2 2026 PDF and the Deccan Herald East Corporation tax-auction article both returned HTTP 403. Their search snippets (C&W: East submarket 26% of Q2 2026 launches; DH: KR Puram zone auction of six properties over tax dues) are unverified by me. I did not report them because I have no verbatim excerpt or confirmed date.

Search-snippet items that were stale or undated: Abhee Ventures 45-acre Gunjur township (28 May 2026), the C&W Q1 2026 East share of 57% (13 May 2026), Mana Verdant Terraces (undated), and various Sarjapur and Budigere plot listings (undated). Pink Line opening dates differ between sources (Wikipedia, NBR, Colliers), so I made no infrastructure claim. All of these came from interested-party or aggregator sources, and none was in the window. This is a valid "nothing new" result for the window, but it reflects limited access to the social platforms rather than proof that nothing was posted there.
